response.sql: WITH patient_lab_data AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, l.IGA, l.IGM FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(PT) as avg_PT, AVG(CASE WHEN IGA IS NOT NULL AND IGM IS NOT NULL THEN IGA - IGM ELSE NULL END) as avg_iga_igm_diff FROM patient_lab_data GROUP BY ID, SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) as overall_iga_igm_mean FROM patient_averages), patient_with_ratio AS (SELECT pa.SEX, pa.avg_PT, pa.avg_iga_igm_diff, CASE WHEN om.overall_iga_igm_mean IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_iga_igm_mean != 0 THEN pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / om.overall_iga_igm_mean ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM patient_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_PT) as avg_PT, AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) as avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM patient_with_ratio GROUP BY SEX
